title: Simulator rounds a margin price and its profit to the cent
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, one range from $0.00: Default Margin % 30, tier A % Off 15.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Type 10 in the Price Part Simulator's Part Cost.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens on the Work Order Matrix tab.

Step 3:

  • Default reads $14.29 and "$4.29 profit" ($10.00 ÷ 0.70 = $14.2857…, rounded to $14.29, $14.29 − $10.00 = $4.29).
  • Tier A reads $12.15 and "$2.15 profit" (15% off $14.29 = $12.1465, rounded to $12.15).
